headline.text: L1 Sollich 1 chiller breaker tripped at 18:14, forcing a *2.5-hour reheat* — back in production at 20:37.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 1 chiller failure drove the longest outage. Sollich 3 had a 36-minute gap where the metal detector wasn't rejecting after air was turned off during belt inspection. Sollich 4 cutting variation partially addressed. Six date-code and foreign-material quality issues are open.
per_plant_summary.L2: Quiet shift. Belt fraying flagged before the metal detector on ML2; maintenance working. Supplier sent a plastic container inside a cookie box — isolated and on hold.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 startup delayed to 2nd shift after 1st-shift cleaning quality misses and repeated oil-flush failures. ML1 completed the 35g-to-60g changeover. MFM sealer was down 90 minutes but sealing defects continue post-restart.

notes.text: L3 will send 4 employees Tuesday for label rework, 7 Wednesday through Friday to clear the pecan backlog.
Emergency order placed for WIP reusable boxes (41123); using substitute 40402 in the interim.
One spare sweco screen pulled from inventory; four 30-inch and five 40-inch screens remain on aisle 11-60E.

resolved.title: Sollich 1 chiller breaker tripped, forced reheat
resolved.summary: Main breaker tripped at 18:14, HMI went dark; chocolate solidified and required two reheat cycles before stirrer would turn.
resolved.resolution: Caleb reset breaker at 18:24; Dakota completed reheats and brought chocolate back into program by 20:33; line running and in temper at 20:37.

resolved.title: Sollich 4 THG bent fingers flinging caramel
resolved.summary: Caramel being flung inside the THG; maintenance found bent fingers and one crooked holder.
resolved.resolution: Caleb replaced 5 outer, 2 inner fingers and 1 holder; reassembled and tested by 22:52; Delia confirmed "working properly" at 23:00.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 circuit breaker tripped on heating
resolved.summary: Circuit breaker tripped; equipment wasn't heating.
resolved.resolution: Breaker reset at 12:29; "everything is heating up like it should now."

resolved.title: Expired condensed milk (10071) disposed
resolved.summary: Most inventory expired August/September; only 173 gallons usable with tomorrow's expiration for the next work order.
resolved.resolution: Angelica disposed of 8 LPNs (Aug/Sep dates) and extended 2 LPNs (R428977, R425906) to 10/20; enough for tomorrow's WO.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 stuck POP-UP on kitchen screen
resolved.summary: Kitchen screen POP-UP wouldn't close; "No" button held an off signal from old unlatch bit in the logic.
resolved.resolution: Leon removed the unlatch bit at 21:12 — "it works, the pop-up closed."

resolved.title: Sollich 3 pistachio pieces on matrix top after clean
resolved.summary: QA found pistachio residue on S3 matrix top post-sanitation.
resolved.resolution: Team re-cleaned the area; Luis confirmed "we already re-clean that area" at 03:44.

resolved.title: Supplier foreign material in cookie box
resolved.summary: Plastic container found inside a cookie box; appears to be a supplier filling tool.

resolved.title: MFM sealer not reaching temperature
resolved.summary: Sealer temp wouldn't climb high enough to seal pouches; line down from start of shift.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance adjusted tightness and cleaned heads; Shane reported "line is up and running now" at 18:49.

resolved.title: ML4 north-side sweco foreign material at install
resolved.summary: Cookie pieces found inside a sweco during installation despite passing ATP and being bagged/tagged.
resolved.resolution: Kevin inspected; EE cleaned and removed all pieces before installing at 13:15.

resolved.title: ML4 buffer tank milk-chocolate carryover
resolved.summary: Dark chocolate flush showed milk chocolate streaks; prior shift did white-chocolate reheat before cleaning pipes.
resolved.resolution: Daniel reported "no longer seeing milk chocolate during the flush" at 18:07.

resolved.title: MFM conveyor C9 stopped
resolved.summary: Conveyor C9 not moving at start of 1st shift.
resolved.resolution: Nathan power-cycled the VFD at 06:39 — "VFD fault and needed to be power cycled."

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 metal detector constantly triggering
needs_attention.summary: Metal detector continuously rejecting product into the bin.
needs_attention.status: Line supervisor notified at 14:36; no resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 wrong best-by date on 6 pallets
needs_attention.summary: Both Matrix 9 and Matrix 10 coded bags with incorrect BB dates; 6 pallets affected.
needs_attention.status: Team beginning rework; date error identified at 07:34.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 Kirkland date-code mismatch on hold
needs_attention.summary: Bag printed 31.03.26; tray label shows correct date 20.07.27; discrepancy discovered during QA check.
needs_attention.status: Affected product on HOLD; determining quantity and corrective action as of 07:39.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 metal detector down 36 minutes at start
needs_attention.summary: Air pressure was turned off during overnight belt inspection; production ran 08:01–08:37 without metal-detector rejection.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance turned air back on; detector rejecting again by 08:37, but 36 minutes of product ran without coverage.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 screw found in Matrix 9 pouch
needs_attention.summary: X-ray check caught a screw in one bag during inspection; fell into reject bin as check was conducted.
needs_attention.status: Area lead examining equipment to determine origin; investigation ongoing as of 10:00.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 labeler malfunction
needs_attention.summary: Labeler generating wrinkled labels; causing accumulation.
needs_attention.status: Troy submitted All Fill service request at 12:32; labels improved but not fully resolved by 03:03.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 4 THG caramel weight/measurement issues
needs_attention.summary: Caramel weight out of range; THG measurement variability affecting depositing.
needs_attention.status: Operator working on it; maintenance still addressing measures as of 04:40.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 international pallets shortage
needs_attention.summary: No international pallets on-site; 5 pallets of rework waiting for materials.
needs_attention.status: Trailer in lot; Tiff working to get pallets delivered as of 08:11.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 4 product cutting variation on one row
needs_attention.summary: Intermittent variation in piece size on one cutting row; could be belt movement or program settings.
needs_attention.status: Erandy opened belt gap, team cleaned rollers/scrapers at 11:31; guillotine belt slightly crooked on east side, maintenance alignment needed.

needs_attention.title: ML2 belt fraying before metal detector
needs_attention.summary: Significant fraying observed on conveyor belt upstream of metal detector during inspection.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance working on it as of 06:23.

needs_attention.title: ML4 startup delayed to 2nd shift
needs_attention.summary: 1st-shift cleaning misses (pre-heat cabinet, refrigerator 2) and repeated oil-flush QA failures; on 2nd tote, still step 2 as of 03:39.
needs_attention.status: Rose announced 2nd shift will start CNC at 09:23; 1st shift finishing south-side push and pre-heat inspection.

needs_attention.title: ML4 ingredient tank 1 left unplugged overnight
needs_attention.summary: Tank at Dep 3 found cold; dark cream solidified inside, sliders stuck.
needs_attention.status: Plugged in to warm; 3rd shift washing tonight; using ingredient tank 2 instead.

needs_attention.title: MFM ongoing sealing defects post-restart
needs_attention.summary: Sealer back online but still producing bags with inadequate seals; operators hand-inspecting to remove defects.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance adjustments made some improvement, but defects continue as of 19:12; staff manually removing bad units.

needs_attention.title: ML4 belt fraying before metal detector
needs_attention.summary: Significant fraying on TG5 belt before metal detector noticed during inspection.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance working on it as of 06:23.

needs_attention.title: ML1 glycogen gauge reading 1
needs_attention.summary: Glycogen gauge stuck at 1; not reading properly.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 05:21; no update posted.
